verdict.rationale: Poke is a general AI assistant, so generating and editing images from prompts is a fair question for it. The evidence never documents image generation or editing. The closest item, creating tables and charts and extracting data from shared images, is an adjacent data-visualization feature, not prompt-based image generation or editing, so it earns no credit.
